It is well known that  $ \text{rank}(B^T B) = \text{rank}(B) $ and  $ B^T B $ is a  $ k\binom{n}{k} \times k\binom{n}{k} $ matrix; since for  $ k \geq 2 $ we have  $ k\binom{n}{k} > \binom{n+1}{k} - 1 $, it follows that 0 is an eigenvalue of  $ B^T B $ with multiplicity  $ k\binom{n}{k} - \binom{n+1}{k} + 1 $. Thus, by Lemma 2.1, -2 is an eigenvalue of the line graph  $ L(BL_n(k - 1, k)) $ with multiplicity  $ k\binom{n}{k} - \binom{n+1}{k} + 1 $.
